design: A hostile fantasy cave bat with a compact charcoal-brown torso, angular fox-like head, medium narrow yellow eyes, pointed ears, a wicked small fanged grin, TWO broad leathery burgundy wings attached to its forelimbs and TWO small clawed hind feet. No extra arms or legs, no cute baby head. Stylized graphic outlines and painted wing membranes, mischievous dungeon pest rather than horror. Flying three-quarter toward RIGHT. Idle four controlled wingbeat poses with torso and head at a fixed horizontal center; tips move but body never slides sideways. Hurt recoils in midair and squints; attack folds wings and dives a short distance right with fangs forward, recovery; dodge banks backward/ducks in air and returns. Entire wing spans, ears and feet fully inside separate padded cells. Second reference supplies ONLY small-figure padded layout, do not copy its orc.
